name: Hyperresearch
description: Runs deep research on a question and returns a report with every citation checked, via a hosted API, a remote MCP server, or an open-source CLI for Claude Code and Codex.

skills.name: Deep Research Run
skills.description: Runs a multi-step research pipeline on one question and returns an adversarially reviewed report with full source provenance.

skills.name: Verify Citations
skills.description: Checks each citation in a document against its source and returns supported, partially supported, unsupported, or wrong-source verdicts.

skills.name: Search the Vault
skills.description: Searches every source and note kept from past runs by full text or by meaning, so new research builds on what was already read.

skills.name: Scholarly Search
skills.description: Searches OpenAlex, Crossref, CORE, ClinicalTrials.gov, SEC EDGAR, and FRED in one query and returns one deduplicated list.

skills.name: Open-Access Full Text
skills.description: Finds legal open-access copies of paywalled papers through Unpaywall, Europe PMC, and CORE and stores the full text in the vault.
